title: HTML Result Scraper
description: Fetch rendered HTML content from URLs using Playwright plus browser fingerprinting and challenge detection.

start_urls.title: Start URLs
start_urls.description: URLs whose rendered HTML should be saved to the dataset.

headless.title: Headless Browser
headless.description: Run browser in headless mode. Set to false locally if a manual challenge must be solved.

wait_until.title: Navigation Wait Until
wait_until.description: Playwright navigation state to wait for before reading HTML.

page_wait_seconds.title: Extra Page Wait Seconds
page_wait_seconds.description: Additional wait after navigation and challenge handling before collecting HTML.

max_retries.title: Max Retries
max_retries.description: How many times to retry a URL after navigation errors or unresolved challenges.

cf_wait_seconds.title: Challenge Wait Timeout Seconds
cf_wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for Cloudflare-style challenges to clear.

cf_refresh_attempts.title: Challenge Refresh Attempts
cf_refresh_attempts.description: How many browser-like refreshes to try when a challenge title is detected.

use_apify_proxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
use_apify_proxy.description: Enable Apify Proxy. Recommended on Apify Cloud for sites that block datacenter traffic.

proxy_groups.title: Proxy Groups
proxy_groups.description: Apify Proxy groups to use when proxy is enabled.

proxy_country.title: Proxy Country
proxy_country.description: Two-letter country code for Apify Proxy exit node.

session_id.title: Proxy Session ID
session_id.description: Optional fixed proxy/session seed. Auto-generated if blank.

fingerprint_seed.title: Fingerprint Seed
fingerprint_seed.description: Optional seed to deterministically select a browser fingerprint.

max_html_chars.title: Max HTML Characters
max_html_chars.description: Optional limit for saved HTML size. Set 0 to save full HTML.
